evidence.description: Front window broken and the ATM in the entryway pried at
About $1,500 in damage to the ATM
Surveillance video shows a person in a face mask and gloves getting out of a vehicle and entering the building
Silver or tan Toyota Tundra pickup with no front plate, a dimmer passenger-side headlight and a rolled-up bed cover, arriving just before 2 a.m.
Tire track left at the scene
Before the break-in, a person resembling the later suspect drove a similar vehicle to the restaurant and photographed the pull-tab machines

unknowns: result of comparing a photo of the pickup's tire tread to the scene track
notes: Time is when the pickup is seen arriving on video, reported as just before 2 a.m. Police list and court documents agree on the date. The restaurant owner posted a photo of the pickup the next day and a member of the public named its owner; court documents do not show police acting on that until the June 2025 arrest. On the police arrest list.
